items.briefing:
Google has warned that AI is increasingly being used by cybercriminals to make attacks more sophisticated and harder to detect — a trend affecting Australian organisations of all sizes, including training providers. Separately, a newly discovered Cisco vulnerability involving authentication weaknesses in API systems serves as a reminder to ensure any network equipment or software is promptly updated when security patches are released.

On the scam front, global efforts to combat fraud are growing, with international anti-scam alliances expanding to include more countries. Stay alert to unusual emails, calls, or messages requesting personal or financial information.

**Tip:** Check with your IT team that all software and network devices are set to receive automatic security updates.

featured.title: Databricks AI helping telcos prevent churn, predict fraud
featured.summary: By linking customer, network and operational data, telcos can spot churn and fraud sooner, while also speeding service and support decisions…
